requirements.label: required-courses
requirements.title: Required Courses (30 credits)

rules.sourceText: Choose one of the following research methods and theory sequences: COM 314 - Communication Research and COM 315 - Communication Theory; OR COM 306 - Modes of Media Criticism and COM 307 - Critical Media Theory

requirements.sourceText: COM 100 - Introduction to Communication 3 credits; COM 120 - Fundamentals of Public Speaking 3 credits; COM 202 - Intercultural Communication 3 credits; COM 206 - Interpersonal Communication 3 credits; COM 208 - Mass Communication 3 credits; COM 210 - Responsible Media Making 3 credits; Choose one of the following research methods and theory sequences: COM 314 - Communication Research 3 credits; COM 315 - Communication Theory 3 credits; OR COM 306 - Modes of Media Criticism 3 credits; COM 307 - Critical Media Theory 3 credits; COM 351 - Team Collaboration and Community Engagement 3 credits; COM 495 - Communication Senior Project 3 credits

requirements.label: electives
requirements.title: Electives (12 credits)
requirements.sourceText: Choose four of the following: COM 346 - Race, Class, and Gender in Media 3 credits; COM 357 - Health Communication 3 credits; COM 358 - Nonverbal Communication 3 credits; COM 365 - Talking Science 3 credits; COM 386 - Special Topics: Issues in Communication 3 credits; COM 387 - Special Topics in Audience Analysis 3 credits; COM 391 - Studio Production 3 credits; COM 400 - Advanced Communication Research 3 credits; COM 401 - Organizational Communication 3 credits; COM 402 - Crisis Communication 3 credits; COM 403 - Strategic Communication 3 credits; COM 404 - Communication for Social Change & Public Advocacy 3 credits; COM 405 - Political Communication 3 credits; COM 406 - Risk Communication 3 credits; COM 407 - Social Media Analytics 3 credits; COM 409 - Public Relations 3 credits; COM 415 - Data Analysis and Storytelling 3 credits; COM 434 - Argumentation and Persuasion 3 credits; COM 435 - Science Communication 3 credits; COM 436 - Environmental Communication 3 credits; COM 487 - Independent Study 0-6 credits; COM 496 - Internship

notes.text: Communication (COM) majors may double major or minor in Journalism (JRN) or Mass Communication (CMM). Required courses that overlap between programs will count towards each program. Double majors and minors cannot get double credit for the same elective. Elective courses will be counted once and only apply to one program.
Communication majors may not minor in Communication and Innovation (CBI).
Advising is available through SoCJ Undergraduate Advising (socjadvising@stonybrook.edu, (631) 632-7403).
